title: Learning Motorola 68000 Assembly
practicalRequirements: Paper traces require no installation. Examples use the original MC68000 instruction set and GNU assembler notation. Executable emulator labs are future work.
seriesPrerequisites: Read Introduction to Computers if programs and files are unfamiliar. The first lesson introduces bits, registers and instruction notation.
nextTopics: Stack use, subroutines, calling conventions and a documented emulator laboratory.
